title: Predicting financial distress in Korean SMEs: a comparison of Elastic Net and tree-based ensemble models
title_zh: 预测韩国中小企业财务困境：弹性网络与基于树的集成模型的比较
title_primary: 预测韩国中小企业财务困境：弹性网络与基于树的集成模型的比较
title_secondary: Predicting financial distress in Korean SMEs: a comparison of Elastic Net and tree-based ensemble models
authors: Youngwoo Jeong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study compares Elastic Net logistic regression with three tree-based ensemble models for one-year-ahead financial distress prediction using 295,416 firm-year observations from Korean SMEs. Financial distress is defined using a forward-looking cash-flow-based criterion requiring both negative operating cash flow relative to total debt and a negative net cash position. Models are developed on 2009–2023 observations using Bayesian optimization and five-fold stratified cross-validation and evaluated on an independent 2024 out-of-time sample. All three tree-based ensemble models achieve stronger threshold-free discrimination than the Elastic Net benchmark. XGBoost achieves the best overall predictive performance, with the highest ROC-AUC (0.8096), PR-AUC (0.5318), and F1-score (0.5445), although its advantage over Random Forest and LightGBM is quantitatively modest. DeLong tests confirm that these ROC-AUC differences are statistically significant despite their small magnitudes. SHAP analysis identifies Debt Dependence, the Interest Coverage Ratio, and operating cash flow relative to sales as the three most influential predictors and reveals nonlinear predictive relationships. Overall, the findings highlight the value of combining a forward-looking distress measure with interpretable nonlinear ensemble models for SME credit risk assessment and early warning. KEYWORDS: Financial distress prediction Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) Cash-flow-based financial distress interpretable machine learning SHAP JEL CLASSIFICATION: C53 G33 C55
abstract_zh: 本研究比较了弹性网络逻辑回归与三种基于树的集成模型在韩国中小企业一年期财务困境预测中的表现，使用了295,416个企业-年度观测值。财务困境采用基于前瞻性现金流的标准进行定义，要求同时满足经营现金流相对于总债务为负以及净现金头寸为负两个条件。模型基于2009年至2023年的观测数据，通过贝叶斯优化和五折分层交叉验证进行开发，并在独立的2024年样本外数据上进行了评估。所有三种基于树的集成模型在无阈值判别能力方面均优于弹性网络基准模型。XGBoost取得了整体最佳的预测性能，其ROC-AUC（0.8096）、PR-AUC（0.5318）和F1分数（0.5445）均为最高，尽管其相对于随机森林和LightGBM的优势在数量上较为有限。DeLong检验确认，尽管这些ROC-AUC差异幅度较小，但在统计上具有显著性。SHAP分析识别出债务依赖度、利息覆盖倍数以及经营现金流与销售额之比为三个最具影响力的预测因子，并揭示了非线性预测关系。总体而言，研究结果凸显了将前瞻性困境度量与可解释的非线性集成模型相结合，对中小企业信用风险评估和早期预警的价值。关键词：财务困境预测；中小企业；基于现金流的财务困境；可解释机器学习；SHAP JEL分类：C53 G33 C55

title: Economic Incentives or Social Norms? Labor Supply Differentials between East and West German Mothers
title_zh: 经济激励还是社会规范？东德与西德母亲的劳动供给差异
title_primary: 经济激励还是社会规范？东德与西德母亲的劳动供给差异
title_secondary: Economic Incentives or Social Norms? Labor Supply Differentials between East and West German Mothers
authors: Bastien Chabé-Ferret, Zainab Iftikhar, JungJae Park
official: 官方在线 2026-05-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper quantifies the contributions of social norms and economic incentives to the 350-hour annual gap in maternal labor supply between East and West Germany. Using a collective model of family formation and labor supply estimated on GSOEP data from 2000–2017, we find that the working-mother stigma accounts for 73 percent of the gap. Economic factors partially offset the norm: higher Western wages raise the opportunity cost of staying home, so equalizing wages in West to the levels in East would nearly double the gap. We show that standard policy reforms may actually widen the regional disparity, and that their effectiveness is conditional on the norm being present: once removed, the same policies have negligible effects.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了社会规范与经济激励对东德与西德之间母亲劳动供给每年350小时差距的贡献。利用基于2000-2017年GSOEP数据估计的家庭形成与劳动供给的集体模型，我们发现，职场母亲污名化解释了这一差距的73%。经济因素部分抵消了规范的影响：西德较高的工资提高了居家母亲的机会成本，因此将西德工资水平与东德拉平将使差距几乎翻倍。我们表明，标准的政策改革实际上可能扩大地区差异，且其有效性以规范的存在为前提：一旦规范消除，同样的政策效果将微乎其微。

title: Tapping into excess capacity: Chinese machinery exports and African industrialization
title_zh: 释放过剩产能：中国机械出口与非洲工业化
title_primary: 释放过剩产能：中国机械出口与非洲工业化
title_secondary: Tapping into excess capacity: Chinese machinery exports and African industrialization
authors: Pak Hung Lam, Yatang Lin, Fangyuan Peng, Jin Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The recent decades have witnessed a remarkable surge in machinery imports from China to African economies. Our study examines the causes and local implications of these imports. Notably, we find that China’s efforts to decommission excess capacity have been a driving force behind this trend. Chinese city industries that face urgent capacity elimination requirements imposed by the government tend to export machinery equipment to emerging markets, particularly African countries with weaker environmental regulations and abundant resources. By using instrumental variables based on China’s annual lists of eliminated capacity, we find mixed effects of machinery imports on African economies. They increase output and value added in recipient industries that use the imported machinery, but have limited effects on employment and intersectoral linkages. Nevertheless, labor markets in affected regions reallocate away from agriculture toward both high-skilled and low-skilled occupations. These regions also experience higher pollution levels and increased nighttime light intensity.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，非洲经济体从中国进口机械设备的数量显著激增。本研究探讨了这些进口的成因及其对当地的影响。值得注意的是，我们发现中国淘汰过剩产能的努力是推动这一趋势的关键因素。面临政府紧迫产能淘汰要求的中国城市产业，倾向于向新兴市场出口机械设备，尤其是那些环境规制较弱且资源丰富的非洲国家。通过利用基于中国年度淘汰产能清单的工具变量，我们发现机械设备进口对非洲经济体的影响喜忧参半。这些进口提升了使用进口机械的接收行业的产出和附加值，但对就业和跨部门关联的影响有限。尽管如此，受影响地区的劳动力市场从农业向高技能和低技能职业重新配置。这些地区还经历了更高的污染水平和夜间灯光强度的增加。

title: Smartphones and Children's Mental Health
title_zh: 智能手机与儿童心理健康
title_primary: 智能手机与儿童心理健康
title_secondary: Smartphones and Children's Mental Health
authors: Veramendi, Gregory, Veramendi, Gregory Francisco
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Children's mental health has deteriorated across high-income countries since the early 2010s, coinciding with the mass adoption of smartphones among young people. I provide the first quasi-experimental evidence on delaying children's smartphone ownership through a community-led policy. Since 2024 the Smartphone Free Childhood movement has coordinated families across the United Kingdom through a "Parent Pact" to delay giving children a smartphone until age 14. Using a matched difference-in-differences design, I compare changes in children's mental-health needs in English schools where a large share of parents signed with changes in similar schools where very few did. Where at least one fifth of families signed, school-recorded social, emotional and mental health need falls by around 8 percent of the counterfactual. At the same time, child psychiatric disability claims, determined independently by the Department for Work and Pensions, also fall by about 6 percent in the same communities. The effects are larger among younger children who are less likely to already have a phone and in neighborhoods where more parents sign the pledge. The findings support coordinated ownership delay as a near-zero-cost complement to school phone bans and statutory age limits, and they give parents causal evidence for delaying a child's first smartphone through the primary-school years.
abstract_zh: 自2010年代初以来，高收入国家儿童的心理健康状况持续恶化，恰逢青少年中智能手机的大规模普及。我通过一项社区主导的政策，首次提供了关于延迟儿童拥有智能手机的准实验证据。自2024年起，“无智能手机童年”运动通过“家长契约”协调英国各地的家庭，将儿童获得智能手机的年龄推迟至14岁。采用匹配的双重差分设计，我比较了在大量家长签署该契约的英格兰学校与极少数家长签署的类似学校中，儿童心理健康需求的变化。在至少五分之一家庭签署的地区，学校记录的社会、情感和心理健康需求较反事实水平下降了约8%。与此同时，由就业与养老金部独立确定的儿童精神残疾索赔在同一社区也下降了约6%。这一效应在年龄较小、更不可能已拥有手机的儿童中更为显著，且在更多家长签署承诺的社区中效果更强。研究结果支持将协调延迟拥有手机作为一种近乎零成本的补充措施，与学校手机禁令和法定年龄限制相辅相成，并为家长提供了在小学阶段延迟孩子首次拥有智能手机的因果证据。

title: A Taxonomy Of Algorithmic Co-Supervision
title_zh: 算法协同监督的分类体系
title_primary: 算法协同监督的分类体系
title_secondary: A Taxonomy Of Algorithmic Co-Supervision
authors: Özdemir, Furkan, Alizadeh, Armin, Benlian, Alexander
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: As organizations increasingly weave algorithmic systems into control processes, managerial authority is shifting from human supervisors alone toward varying hybrid arrangements in which humans and algorithms jointly control workers. So far, we lack a sound conceptual basis for categorizing and comparing these arrangements across organizations. In this paper, we examine algorithmic cosupervision (ACoS) as a hybrid control mode in which supervisors and AC systems jointly direct, evaluate, and discipline workers. Building on prior literature and an analysis of 14 real-world ACoS settings, we propose a taxonomy that conceptualizes the phenomenon. We identify two meta-dimensions, control collaboration and control enactment, and six dimensions that enable researchers to categorize and compare ACoS across organizations. We demonstrate the taxonomy’s applicability through three ACoS examples. The proposed taxonomy advances understanding and provides a structured framework for studying emerging human–algorithmic supervisory arrangements in organizations.
abstract_zh: 随着组织日益将算法系统融入控制流程，管理权威正从仅由人类主管承担，转向人类与算法共同控制工人的多种混合安排。迄今为止，我们缺乏一个坚实的理论基础来对这些跨组织的安排进行分类和比较。本文探讨了算法共同监督（ACoS）作为一种混合控制模式，其中主管与AC系统共同指导、评估和约束工人。基于既有文献及对14个实际ACoS情境的分析，我们提出了一种概念化该现象的分类体系。我们识别出两个元维度——控制协作与控制执行，以及六个维度，使研究者能够跨组织对ACoS进行分类和比较。通过三个ACoS实例，我们展示了该分类体系的适用性。所提出的分类体系增进了理解，并为研究组织中新兴的人机监督安排提供了结构化框架。

title: 金融科技创新与企业跨国供应链拓展
title_zh: 金融科技创新与企业跨国供应链拓展
title_primary: 金融科技创新与企业跨国供应链拓展
authors: 李震, 柴范, 方一安, 赵春明
official: 官方发布 2026-08-10 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 金融科技是提升金融服务实体经济质效、支持企业“出海”的重要支撑。本文利用大语言模型识别中国商业银行金融科技专利,依托银行和企业的关系网络构造2013-2023年我国上市公司面临的银行金融科技创新水平,结合FactSet Revere全球供应链数据,考察银行金融科技创新对企业跨国供应链拓展的影响。研究发现,银行金融科技创新显著增加企业国际客户合同数量,促进国际客户网络拓展,但对国际供应商网络的作用相对有限,其主要推动了企业跨国供应链向下游延伸,且这种影响在非国有、中小规模、无通道业务,以及地区金融监管环境相对严格的企业中更为明显。银行金融科技创新通过信息识别、个性化信贷配置及风险承担机制,促进企业开展国际客户合作。本文从跨国供应链视角丰富了金融科技赋能实体经济和支持企业“出海”的经验证据。

title: Money (Not) to Burn: Payments for Ecosystem Services to Reduce Crop Residue Burning
title_zh: （不）烧钱：减少作物秸秆焚烧的生态系统服务付费
title_primary: （不）烧钱：减少作物秸秆焚烧的生态系统服务付费
title_secondary: Money (Not) to Burn: Payments for Ecosystem Services to Reduce Crop Residue Burning
authors: Kelsey Jack, Seema Jayachandran, Namrata Kala, Rohini Pande
official: 官方在线 2026-02-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Particulate matter significantly reduces life expectancy in India. We use a randomized controlled trial in the Indian state of Punjab to evaluate the effectiveness of conditional cash transfers (also known as payments for ecosystem services, or PES) in reducing crop residue burning, which is a major contributor to the region's poor air quality. Credit constraints and distrust may make farmers less likely to comply with standard PES contracts, which only pay the participant after verification of compliance. We randomize paying a portion of the money upfront and unconditionally. Despite receiving a lower reward for compliance, farmers offered partial upfront payment are 8-11 percentage points more likely to comply than are farmers offered the standard contract. Burning measures derived from satellite imagery indicate that PES with upfront payments significantly reduced burning, while standard PES payments were inframarginal. We also show that PES with an upfront component is a cost-effective way to improve India's air quality.
abstract_zh: 颗粒物显著缩短了印度人口的预期寿命。我们在印度旁遮普邦开展了一项随机对照试验，评估有条件现金转移（亦称为生态系统服务付费，简称PES）在减少作物残茬焚烧方面的有效性，而作物残茬焚烧是该地区空气质量差的主要贡献因素。信贷约束和不信任可能使农民不太愿意遵守标准的PES合同，这类合同仅在验证合规后才向参与者支付款项。我们随机化处理，将部分款项预先无条件支付。尽管合规奖励较低，但接受部分预付款项的农民比接受标准合同的农民合规可能性高出8至11个百分点。基于卫星影像的焚烧测量表明，带有预付款项的PES显著减少了焚烧行为，而标准PES支付则处于边际内。我们还证明，包含预付款项的PES是改善印度空气质量的一种成本效益高的方式。

title: DP7 An Empirical Investigation into the Causes of the Failure of the Monetary Model of the Exchange Rate
title_zh: DP7 汇率货币模型失效原因的实证研究
title_primary: DP7 汇率货币模型失效原因的实证研究
title_secondary: DP7 An Empirical Investigation into the Causes of the Failure of the Monetary Model of the Exchange Rate
authors: Michael R. Wickens, Peter N Smith, Giuseppe Bertola, Ricardo Caballero, Willem Buiter 等
official: 官方在线 1984-03-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper is to attempt to provide measures of the relative importance of the likely principal causes of the failure of the monetary model. A second objective is to test the random walk hypothesis for exchange rates. The methodology employed is new and has wide application elsewhere. It involves explicitly modelling the misspecification by time series techniques. The results, which are for the sterling-United States Dollar and Deutschemark-United States Dollar exchange rates, confirm the importance of the breakdown of the PPP assumption but they also show that misspecification of the money market is equally important. Whilst a random walk model is found to provide a very good fit, it is shown that lagged information can be used to improve the explanation of the spot exchange rate and hence the random walk hypothesis can be rejected.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在量化货币模型失败的主要潜在原因的相对重要性，并检验汇率随机游走假说。本文采用了一种具有广泛适用性的新方法，通过时间序列技术对模型设定偏误进行显式建模。基于英镑-美元及德国马克-美元汇率数据的实证结果表明：购买力平价假设的失效是重要因素，但货币市场设定偏误同样具有同等重要性。尽管随机游走模型拟合效果良好，但研究发现滞后信息可用于改进即期汇率的解释力，因此随机游走假说可被拒绝。

title: Within-group inequality and caste-based crimes in India
title_zh: 印度群体内不平等与基于种姓的犯罪
title_primary: 印度群体内不平等与基于种姓的犯罪
title_secondary: Within-group inequality and caste-based crimes in India
authors: Kanishka Bhowmick, Indraneel Dasgupta, Sarmistha Pal
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how within-group inequality, by influencing the group bias of state institutions, affects the cost-benefit calculus of individuals engaging in identity-assertive behaviour, that results in police complaints regarding hate crimes. We develop a two-stage contest model of between-group conflict, where the relative influence of a group over institutions, determined by an initial contest, affects subsequent hierarchy-establishing interaction between individuals belonging to opposing groups. Applying this model to caste conflict in India, we find that greater inequality among non-Scheduled Caste and non-Scheduled Tribe (non-SC/ST) Hindus reduces the registered rate of crimes against SCs by non-SC/ST Hindus, and the rate at which such registered crimes lead to conviction. Using state-level annual crime and household consumption data over 2005–2021, we find empirical support for these hypotheses. Our analysis suggests that greater equality within dominant groups might reduce institution-capture by them and thereby improve both reporting and punishment of aggression against marginalized groups.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了群体内不平等如何通过影响国家机构的群体偏向，进而影响个体参与身份彰显行为的成本收益计算，此类行为最终导致针对仇恨犯罪的警方投诉。我们构建了一个两阶段群体间冲突的竞争模型，其中群体对机构相对影响力由初始竞争决定，并影响后续对立群体个体间确立等级关系的互动。将此模型应用于印度的种姓冲突，我们发现，非在册种姓与非在册部落（非SC/ST）印度教徒内部更大的不平等，降低了非SC/ST印度教徒对SC群体犯罪登记率，以及此类登记犯罪导致定罪的比率。利用2005年至2021年邦级年度犯罪和家庭消费数据，我们为这些假设找到了实证支持。我们的分析表明，主导群体内部更大的平等可能减少他们对机构的俘获，从而改善对边缘群体遭受侵犯行为的举报与惩罚。

title: Effects of disability benefits on the employment of low‐skilled youth: Evidence from France
title_zh: 残疾津贴对低技能青年就业的影响：来自法国的证据
title_primary: 残疾津贴对低技能青年就业的影响：来自法国的证据
title_secondary: Effects of disability benefits on the employment of low‐skilled youth: Evidence from France
authors: Sylvain Chareyron, Naomie Mahmoudi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this article, we assess the effect of the French disability benefits program on the employment of low‐skilled youth. Using the French Labour Force Survey, we exploit the age discontinuity in the program eligibility to instrument the effect of this allowance on employment. The results show that receipt of the French disability benefits program reduces the probability of employment for low‐skilled youth with disabilities. However, the effect differs markedly by gender: it is significantly higher for women, while no effect is detectable in men.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了法国残疾人福利计划对低技能青年就业的影响。利用法国劳动力调查数据，我们借助该计划资格认定中的年龄断点，将此项津贴对就业的影响作为工具变量进行分析。结果表明，领取法国残疾人福利计划津贴会降低低技能残疾青年的就业概率。然而，该影响存在显著的性别差异：对女性的影响明显更高，而对男性则未发现显著影响。

title: The Long Shadow of Housing Discrimination: Evidence from Racial Covenants
title_zh: 住房歧视的长期阴影：来自种族契约的证据
title_primary: 住房歧视的长期阴影：来自种族契约的证据
title_secondary: The Long Shadow of Housing Discrimination: Evidence from Racial Covenants
authors: Aradhya Sood, Kevin Ehrman-Solberg
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Racial covenants in housing deeds were widely used in the United States during the early 20th century to segregate neighborhoods. In 1948, the Supreme Court decision in Shelley v. Kraemer made racial covenants unenforceable in court, stopping short of prohibiting them entirely. We surmise that even after losing their judicial enforceability, such covenants could have shaped segregation if they served as a focal point for coordination on an initial equilibrium in neighborhood formation, a context characterized by investment durability and path dependency. To test this hypothesis, we assemble novel parcel-level data on racial covenants and develop a quasi-experimental design that exploits delays between covenant execution and housing construction to isolate exposure to enforceable covenants at the time neighborhoods were built. Covenant enforceability indeed affected early-stage neighborhood formation in terms of housing characteristics, public infrastructure placement, and the composition of initial residents. These early differences proved durable: Enforceable covenants account for 6–24% of the observed neighborhood racial segregation from 1980 to 2020 and 3.1–4.4% of housing price differentials in the 21st century. We conclude that by coordinating beliefs and decisions during neighborhood formation, the law generated spatial inequality that has long outlived racial covenants themselves.
abstract_zh: 20世纪初，美国住房契约中的种族限制条款被广泛用于实施社区隔离。1948年，最高法院在谢利诉克雷默案中裁定此类条款在法庭上不可强制执行，但并未完全禁止其存在。我们推测，即便失去司法强制力，这些条款仍可能通过充当社区形成初期均衡协调的焦点机制（在投资耐久性与路径依赖特征显著的背景下）影响种族隔离格局。为验证这一假说，我们构建了包含种族限制条款的新型宗地级数据集，并利用条款执行与住房建设之间的时间差设计准实验框架，以识别社区建设时期可执行条款的暴露程度。研究发现，条款的可执行性确实影响了社区形成初期的住房特征、公共基础设施布局及首批居民构成。这些早期差异展现出持久性：可执行条款可解释1980-2020年间观测到的社区种族隔离现象的6-24%，以及21世纪房价差异的3.1-4.4%。我们得出结论：法律通过协调社区形成过程中的信念与决策，催生了远超种族限制条款存续期的空间不平等。

title: Congestion Pricing and EMS Response Time: Evidence From New York City
title_zh: 拥堵收费与急救响应时间：来自纽约市的证据
title_primary: 拥堵收费与急救响应时间：来自纽约市的证据
title_secondary: Congestion Pricing and EMS Response Time: Evidence From New York City
authors: Yulia Chikish, Gregory J. Colman, Dhaval M. Dave, Brad R. Humphreys, Zachary Santamaria 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th 2025 – affects emergency medical service (EMS) response performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City's congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design applied to approximately 1.6 million EMS incidents, we find that the January 2025 implementation of congestion pricing reduced passenger vehicle traffic by roughly 21 percent near the boundary and improved total EMS travel times by 63–70 seconds, approximately 5–6 percent. Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.
abstract_zh: 全球各大城市已普遍采用拥堵收费政策以减少城市交通拥堵，其在提升通行速度、降低事故率及改善空气质量方面的效益已有充分文献佐证。本文识别出一项新的外部效益：急救医疗服务响应速度的提升。我们首次提供了关于纽约市拥堵收费计划——美国首个于2025年1月5日实施的综合性区域拥堵收费系统——如何影响急救医疗服务响应绩效的证据。利用纽约市拥堵缓解区在第60街的清晰地理边界，并结合对约160万起急救医疗事件的双重断点回归设计，我们发现2025年1月实施的拥堵收费使边界附近乘用车交通量减少约21%，并将急救医疗总行程时间缩短63至70秒，降幅约为5%至6%。该效应迅速显现，且几乎没有证据表明其向邻近区域产生转移效应。纽约消防局同期发布的将患者送往最近医院的指令干扰了标准双重差分估计，但未影响我们基于边界的识别策略。这些发现表明，拥堵收费的成本效益分析因忽略应急响应改善而系统性地低估了净社会效益。

title: Memory Overload and Asymmetric Underreaction
title_zh: 记忆过载与非对称性反应不足
title_primary: 记忆过载与非对称性反应不足
title_secondary: Memory Overload and Asymmetric Underreaction
authors: L. Goette, Hua-Jing Han, Benson Tsz Kin Leung
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We show that greater memory overload results in a disproportionately greater underreaction to belief-challenging information compared to belief-confirming information. In an experiment, we keep constant the information subjects receive but vary the difficulty of memorizing the signals. In the treatment condition, the preceding signal disappears as the next signal appears; in the control condition, the preceding signal remains visible. Memory load is therefore greater in the treatment than in the control condition. We find that in the treatment condition, subjects underreact more to belief-challenging information than in the control condition, but updating to belief-confirming information is not significantly affected. Our results caution against information campaigns that ignore the roles of memory load and attention.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，记忆负荷的增大，会导致对挑战信念的信息反应不足的程度，相较于对确认信念的信息，出现不成比例的加剧。在一项实验中，我们保持受试者接收的信息不变，但改变记忆信号的难度。在实验处理条件下，前一个信号随着下一个信号的出现而消失；在控制条件下，前一个信号保持可见。因此，处理条件下的记忆负荷高于控制条件。我们发现，在处理条件下，受试者对挑战信念的信息反应不足程度高于控制条件，但对确认信念的信息更新则未受到显著影响。我们的结果警示，忽视记忆负荷和注意力作用的信息宣传活动可能存在问题。

title: Taxing Labor: Firm R&D, Automation and the Labor Share
title_zh: 征税劳动：企业研发、自动化与劳动份额
title_primary: 征税劳动：企业研发、自动化与劳动份额
title_secondary: Taxing Labor: Firm R&D, Automation and the Labor Share
authors: Hyejin Ku, Uta Schönberg, Ragnhild Schreiner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides new micro-level evidence on how labor taxation shapes firm behavior, exploiting an EU-mandated payroll tax reform in Norway. Combining administrative and survey data, we find that firms facing larger tax increases sharply cut employment but also increased R&D spending, implemented labor cost-saving innovations, and adopted more automation. While these responses led to improvements in labor and total factor productivity within the firm, the firm’s labor share fell. These effects persisted even after the tax hike was unexpectedly reversed three years later, suggesting a lasting shift toward more capital-intensive production in response to higher labor costs.
abstract_zh: 本文利用挪威一项欧盟强制实施的工资税改革，提供了关于劳动税收如何影响企业行为的新微观证据。结合行政与调查数据，我们发现，面临较大税负增加的企业大幅削减了就业，但同时增加了研发支出，实施了节约劳动力成本的创新，并采用了更多自动化措施。尽管这些反应带来了企业内部劳动生产率和全要素生产率的提升，但企业的劳动份额却下降了。这些效应在三年后税负意外逆转时依然持续存在，表明企业为应对更高的劳动力成本，已向更资本密集型生产方式发生了持久性转变。

title: Public Economic Benefits of Agricultural Conservation: Evidence from Housing Markets
title_zh: 农业保护对公共经济利益的贡献：来自住房市场的证据
title_primary: 农业保护对公共经济利益的贡献：来自住房市场的证据
title_secondary: Public Economic Benefits of Agricultural Conservation: Evidence from Housing Markets
authors: Wei Zhang, Yanggu Li, Pengfei Liu
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-04-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Conservation on working agricultural lands provides many ecosystem services, and public funding for conservation programs has increased substantially over the past two decades. This study estimates the public economic benefits of agricultural conservation through its capitalization in US housing markets. We spatially link USDA Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP) data with individual property transactions to estimate residents’ valuation of environmental amenities provided by conservation practices. Using a repeat-sales model, we find that agricultural conservation increases local housing prices, with benefits capitalized up to 20 miles. In addition, we show that conservation payments made two years ago have larger impacts than those made in the previous year, suggesting the importance of accounting for the temporal dynamics of conservation impacts. We also examine the heterogeneous impacts across practices targeting different resource concerns or with different design lifespans. Our results highlight the positive impact of agricultural conservation on nearby communities.
abstract_zh: 在耕作农业用地上实施保护措施提供了多种生态系统服务，过去二十年间，针对保护项目的公共资金投入显著增加。本研究通过农业保护在美国住房市场中的资本化效应，评估其公共经济效益。我们将美国农业部环境质量激励计划（EQIP）数据与个体房产交易记录进行空间关联，以估算居民对保护实践所提供的环境便利设施的估值。采用重复销售模型，我们发现农业保护提升了当地房价，其效益可资本化至20英里范围内。此外，研究显示，两年前实施的保护支付对房价的影响大于前一年实施的，这表明在考虑保护影响时需重视其时间动态性。我们还考察了针对不同资源问题或具有不同设计寿命的保护措施所产生的异质性影响。我们的研究结果凸显了农业保护对邻近社区的积极影响。

title: Are You Okay? Effects of a National Peer-Support Campaign on Mental Health
title_zh: 你还好吗？全国同伴支持运动对心理健康的影响
title_primary: 你还好吗？全国同伴支持运动对心理健康的影响
title_secondary: Are You Okay? Effects of a National Peer-Support Campaign on Mental Health
authors: Black, Nicole, Deer, Lachlan, S.Kunz, Johannes, Johnston, David W.
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: National public health awareness campaigns that emphasize peer-to-peer support are increasingly adopted, but evidence on the effects of peer-based programs at scale remains limited. Using quasi-experimental methods, we examine whether the prominent nationwide “R U OK? Day” campaign affects short-term mental health outcomes in Australia. Leveraging survey and administrative data, we find R U OK? Day leads to a 4% of a standard deviation increase in self-reported mental wellbeing, with the effect particularly pronounced among middle-aged males who experience a 9% of a standard deviation increase. We find no detectable effects on mental health care utilization, and we detect no statistically significant changes in suicide-related deaths in the short run, though the mortality outcomes are rare and power is limited. Our results underscore that peer-based campaigns can improve mental wellbeing, especially for high-risk groups, and point to a distinction between short-run psychological responses and outcomes that require behavioural follow-through.
abstract_zh: 强调同伴支持的国家公共卫生意识宣传活动日益普及，但关于大规模同伴项目效果的证据仍然有限。我们采用准实验方法，考察了澳大利亚全国性知名活动“你还好吗？日”对短期心理健康结果的影响。利用调查和行政数据，我们发现“你还好吗？日”使自我报告的心理健康水平提高了标准差的4%，其中中年男性的效果尤为显著，达到了标准差的9%。我们未发现该活动对心理健康服务利用产生可检测的影响，也未在短期内检测到自杀相关死亡率的统计显著变化，尽管死亡结果较为罕见且统计效力有限。我们的研究结果强调，同伴宣传活动能够改善心理健康，尤其是针对高风险群体，并指出了短期心理反应与需要行为跟进的结果之间的区别。

title: Divergent peri-urban land transitions and their carbon stock implications: A multi-method diagnostic framework applied to Hawassa, Ethiopia
title_zh: 城乡边缘地带土地转型差异及其碳储量影响：应用于埃塞俄比亚哈瓦萨的多方法诊断框架
title_primary: 城乡边缘地带土地转型差异及其碳储量影响：应用于埃塞俄比亚哈瓦萨的多方法诊断框架
title_secondary: Divergent peri-urban land transitions and their carbon stock implications: A multi-method diagnostic framework applied to Hawassa, Ethiopia
authors: Safisa Abishu Neme, Dejene Tesema Bulti, Gebrechristos Nuriye Dolebo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Rapid urbanisation in sub-Saharan Africa transforms peri-urban land, yet the relative vulnerability of farmland and natural vegetation remains poorly understood. This study develops an integrated diagnostic framework to disentangle divergent land-transition pathways in Hawassa, Ethiopia (1984–2054), a secondary city representative of the East African Rift Valley. The framework combines class-specific driver analysis, spatial heterogeneity mapping, landscape fragmentation metrics, intensity analysis, and carbon stock-change modelling. Over four decades, urban area expanded more than seven-fold, primarily displacing peri-urban smallholder agriculture (4957 ha lost; –65.7%), while natural vegetative cover expanded moderately (+3073 ha; +37.6%). Agricultural conversion is driven by economic centrality and population pressure, whereas vegetation dynamics respond to proximity-based regulatory and biophysical controls. These effects are spatially heterogeneous, creating measurable leakage where lakeshore protection displaces development onto outlying farmland. Agricultural conversion produces fragmented landscapes; vegetation change involves larger, more cohesive patches. Urban expansion systematically targets agriculture and avoids vegetation, but once agricultural reserves are depleted, vegetation becomes vulnerable. Carbon stock modelling shows historical vegetation gains partially offset emissions from agricultural conversion; however, a business-as-usual scenario yields net emissions costing 21.0 million USD, while ecological protection yields net sequestration benefits of 10.7 million USD, and urban development results in 124.6 million USD in climate damages. These findings demonstrate that sustainable peri-urban land governance must differentiate between productive farmland and protective vegetation, employing agricultural zoning, ecosystem connectivity corridors, and densification incentives to manage trade-offs between food security, carbon sequestration, and urban growth.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的快速城市化正在改变城郊土地，然而农田与自然植被的相对脆弱性仍鲜为人知。本研究构建了一个综合诊断框架，以解析埃塞俄比亚哈瓦萨（1984–2054年）这一东非裂谷带典型次级城市中分化的土地转型路径。该框架结合了类别特定驱动因素分析、空间异质性制图、景观破碎化指标、强度分析及碳储量变化建模。过去四十年间，城市面积扩张超过七倍，主要侵占城郊小农农业用地（损失4957公顷，–65.7%），而自然植被覆盖适度增加（+3073公顷，+37.6%）。农业转化受经济中心性和人口压力驱动，而植被动态则受基于邻近性的规制和生物物理因素控制。这些效应在空间上呈现异质性，产生可测度的泄漏效应，即湖岸保护将开发活动转移至外围农田。农业转化导致景观破碎化；植被变化则涉及更大、更连贯的斑块。城市扩张系统性地瞄准农业用地而避开植被，但一旦农业储备耗尽，植被便面临脆弱性。碳储量模型显示，历史植被增长部分抵消了农业转化产生的排放；然而，照常情景下净排放造成2100万美元损失，而生态保护情景产生1070万美元净固碳收益，城市发展情景则导致1.246亿美元气候损害。这些发现表明，可持续的城郊土地治理必须区分生产性农田与保护性植被，采用农业分区、生态系统连通廊道及密度化激励措施，以管理粮食安全、碳固存与城市增长之间的权衡。

title: Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality II
title_zh: 集体完备性与定价-对冲对偶性 II
title_primary: 集体完备性与定价-对冲对偶性 II
title_secondary: Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality II
authors: Alessandro Doldi, Marco Frittelli, Marco Maggis
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper complements and extends Doldi, Frittelli and Maggis, Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality, Math. Finan. Econ. 19, 757-784 (2025), by studying collective pricing and hedging when admissible risk exchanges form a finitely generated convex cone. The collective First Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing and the collective pricing-hedging duality are extended to this setting. A key contribution is a closedness result showing that no collective arbitrage implies the closedness of the aggregate feasibility cone combining infinite-dimensional trading opportunities with finite-dimensional exchanges. The paper also proves that no-collective-arbitrage prices for vectors of contingent claims form a relatively open convex set. Finally, strong collective replicability is introduced and shown to be equivalent to price uniqueness. This leads to an enhanced collective Second Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing, providing equivalent characterizations of collective completeness and strong collective completeness in terms of the uniqueness of the collective equivalent martingale measure. We highlight that several core aspects of the theory are substantially altered when exchanges belong to a convex cone rather than a vector space.
abstract_zh: 本文对Doldi、Frittelli与Maggis的《集体完备性与定价-对冲对偶》（Math. Finan. Econ. 19, 757-784 (2025)）进行了补充与拓展，研究了当可接受风险交换构成有限生成凸锥时的集体定价与对冲问题。本文将集体资产定价第一基本定理及集体定价-对冲对偶推广至该设定。核心贡献在于一项闭性结论：无集体套利意味着聚合可行性锥的闭性，该锥结合了无限维交易机会与有限维交换。本文还证明了无集体套利条件下未定权益向量的价格构成相对开凸集。最后，本文引入强集体可复制性概念，并证明其等价于价格唯一性。由此推导出增强的集体资产定价第二基本定理，以集体等价鞅测度的唯一性为条件，给出了集体完备性与强集体完备性的等价刻画。我们强调，当交换属于凸锥而非向量空间时，该理论的若干核心方面会发生实质性改变。

title: Queuing, Service Time, and Price Dynamics in Residential Mortgage Lending
title_zh: 住宅抵押贷款中的排队、服务时间与价格动态
title_primary: 住宅抵押贷款中的排队、服务时间与价格动态
title_secondary: Queuing, Service Time, and Price Dynamics in Residential Mortgage Lending
authors: Akos Horvath, Benjamin S. Kay
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Building on queuing theory, we develop and empirically validate a novel theoretical model of residential mortgage supply. Our model gives insight into how the stochastic arrival and sequential servicing of loan applications affect mortgage origination. The model provides closed-form predictions for lenders’ optimal response to changes in the level and price elasticity of mortgage demand. Using confidential HMDA data, we estimate that a one standard deviation increase in mortgage demand raises mortgage rate spreads by 3 to 8 basis points, loan quantities by 20 to 32 percent, and application processing times by 3 to 5 days. We also provide empirical evidence for the model prediction that a higher elasticity of mortgage demand moderates price increases due to demand shocks, which can limit lenders’ exploitation of their market power.
abstract_zh: 基于排队理论，我们构建并实证验证了一个关于住宅抵押贷款供给的新型理论模型。该模型揭示了贷款申请的随机到达与顺序处理如何影响抵押贷款发放。模型为贷款机构应对抵押贷款需求水平及价格弹性变化的最优反应提供了闭式解。利用保密的HMDA数据，我们估计抵押贷款需求每增加一个标准差，抵押贷款利率价差将上升3至8个基点，贷款数量增加20%至32%，申请处理时间延长3至5天。我们还为模型预测提供了实证证据：更高的抵押贷款需求弹性会抑制需求冲击导致的价格上涨，从而限制贷款机构对其市场势力的利用。

title: Employment aspirations of young agroindustry workers in Peru – Poverty, gender and role models
title_zh: 秘鲁年轻农业产业工人的就业期望——贫困、性别与榜样角色
title_primary: 秘鲁年轻农业产业工人的就业期望——贫困、性别与榜样角色
title_secondary: Employment aspirations of young agroindustry workers in Peru – Poverty, gender and role models
authors: Monica Schuster, Miet Maertens
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Aspirations are a key dimension of wellbeing but remain underexplored among agrifood system workers. This study examines the employment aspirations of 528 young individuals in Peru who intended to work in the horticultural agro-industry, using two-round panel survey data and econometric methods. Between survey rounds, 414 respondents entered employment for the first time, allowing us to analyze how early labor market experiences shape aspirations related to income, occupation, and promotion. We assess how aspirations are influenced by gender, poverty status, and the presence of workplace role models. The findings show that agro-industry jobs can raise aspirations and help reduce gender- and poverty-related gaps. Supervisors—especially those who are female and age-proximate—play a significant role in shaping youth aspirations, particularly for women. The study highlights the potential of targeted employment strategies, such as thoughtful supervisor-worker matching as practical tools to promote more equitable labor outcomes and foster upward mobility among rural youth.
abstract_zh: 愿望是福祉的一个关键维度，但在农业食品系统工作者中仍未得到充分探讨。本研究利用两轮面板调查数据和计量经济学方法，考察了秘鲁528名有意从事园艺农业产业工作的年轻人的就业愿望。在调查轮次之间，414名受访者首次进入就业市场，使我们能够分析早期劳动力市场经历如何塑造与收入、职业和晋升相关的愿望。我们评估了性别、贫困状况以及工作场所榜样人物的存在如何影响这些愿望。研究发现，农业产业工作能够提升愿望，并有助于缩小性别和贫困相关的差距。主管——尤其是女性且年龄相近的主管——在塑造青年愿望方面发挥着重要作用，对女性尤为显著。本研究强调了有针对性的就业策略的潜力，如精心设计的主管与员工匹配，作为促进更公平的劳动成果和推动农村青年向上流动的实用工具。

title: Political connections, contract imperfections, and firm outsourcing
title_zh: 政治关联、合同不完全性与企业外包
title_primary: 政治关联、合同不完全性与企业外包
title_secondary: Political connections, contract imperfections, and firm outsourcing
authors: Yi Zhang, Hein Roelfsema
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the impact of political connections on firms’ make-or-buy decisions, focusing on outsourcing intensity. We develop a stylized model to illustrate two mechanisms. For small buyers, political connections mitigate bargaining disadvantages and increase the buyer’s share of revenue, which strengthens incentives to undertake headquarters investment and thus raises the attractiveness of outsourcing (a bargaining-power channel). For large buyers, political connections may increase the reputational costs of opportunistic behavior, thereby reducing hold-up risk, encouraging supplier investment, and increasing outsourcing (a reputational-discipline channel). For buyers of intermediate size, political connections have little effect, as such firms neither face severe bargaining disadvantages nor strong reputational constraints. Using data on Chinese listed firms from 2010 to 2020, we find evidence consistent with these mechanisms: political connections are associated with higher outsourcing intensity for small and large firms, while the relationship is weak for medium-sized firms.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了政治关联对企业自制或外购决策的影响，重点关注外包强度。我们构建了一个简化模型以阐述两种机制。对于小型买方，政治关联缓解了议价劣势，增加了买方在收入中的份额，从而强化了进行总部投资的激励，进而提升了外包的吸引力（议价能力渠道）。对于大型买方，政治关联可能增加机会主义行为的声誉成本，从而降低套牢风险，鼓励供应商投资，并促进外包（声誉约束渠道）。对于规模居中的买方，政治关联影响甚微，因为此类企业既未面临严重的议价劣势，也未受到强烈的声誉约束。利用2010年至2020年中国上市公司数据，我们发现了与这些机制相一致的证据：政治关联与小型和大型企业的外包强度呈正相关，而对中型企业而言，这一关系较弱。

title: The resolution of uncertainty in the value and probability domains
title_zh: 价值与概率领域不确定性的消解
title_primary: 价值与概率领域不确定性的消解
title_secondary: The resolution of uncertainty in the value and probability domains
authors: Eungik Lee, Kathleen Ngangoue, Andrew Schotter
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We compare preferences for temporal resolution when uncertainty is resolved over a probability rather than a value. In various theoretical frameworks, preferences over gradual versus one-shot resolution do not depend on whether values or probabilities define the main object of uncertainty. In our experiment, however, we find that preferences for resolution vary with the type of prize: subjects prefer gradual resolution for uncertain value prizes, whereas no such preference emerges for uncertain probability prizes. To explain our findings, we propose an explanation based on what we call “process utility”.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了当不确定性通过概率而非价值来消解时，人们对时间分辨率的偏好。在多种理论框架下，对于渐进式与一次性分辨的偏好并不取决于不确定性主要对象是由价值还是概率定义。然而，在我们的实验中，我们发现对分辨率的偏好随奖品类型而变化：对于不确定的价值奖品，受试者偏好渐进式分辨；而对于不确定的概率奖品，则未出现此类偏好。为解释我们的发现，我们提出了一种基于我们称之为“过程效用”的解释。

title: Criteria for Choosing Crop Protection Strategies: Comparative Perspectives From Farmers, Advisors and Researchers
title_zh: 作物保护策略选择标准：农民、顾问与研究人员的比较视角
title_primary: 作物保护策略选择标准：农民、顾问与研究人员的比较视角
title_secondary: Criteria for Choosing Crop Protection Strategies: Comparative Perspectives From Farmers, Advisors and Researchers
authors: Marianne Lefebvre, Laure Latruffe, Maxime Colin, Adeline Alonso Ugaglia, Julie Borg 等
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Achieving ambitious pesticide reduction goals calls for collaboration and shared vision among multiple stakeholders. This study evaluates whether this is the case in three French pesticide‐intensive production sectors: vine‐growing, orchards and fruits & vegetables farming. To do so, it uses the Q‐method to assess farmers' decision‐making criteria when selecting crop protection strategies, taking stock of technical, economic, and organisational constraints, as well as health and environmental impacts. It also compares these criteria with the perspectives of researchers and advisors on farmers' priorities. After combining a factor analysis with a fractional multilogit model accounting for factor loadings, the findings reveal four distinct profiles across the sample: a competitiveness‐oriented approach; a focus on reducing health and environmental impacts; a risk management perspective; and an integrated vision combining multiple priorities. Being a farmer, advisor or researcher significantly influences the likelihood of belonging to one profile or another. However, close interactions between farmers, researchers, and advisors help bridge differences in priorities, fostering more closely aligned perspectives on crop protection strategies. These results point to key indicators that researchers and advisors could leverage to better inform farmers about alternative crop protection methods, ultimately supporting more sustainable agricultural practices.
abstract_zh: 摘要 实现雄心勃勃的农药减量目标，需要多方利益相关者的协作与共同愿景。本研究评估了法国三个农药密集型生产部门——葡萄种植、果园及果蔬种植——是否具备这一条件。为此，采用Q方法评估农户在选择作物保护策略时的决策标准，综合考虑技术、经济和组织约束，以及健康与环境影响。同时，将这些标准与研究人员和顾问对农户优先事项的看法进行比较。通过将因子分析与考虑因子载荷的分数多项逻辑模型相结合，研究结果揭示了样本中四种不同的特征类型：以竞争力为导向的方法；侧重于减少健康与环境影响的方法；风险管理视角；以及综合多重优先事项的整体愿景。作为农户、顾问或研究人员，显著影响归属于某一特征类型的可能性。然而，农户、研究人员和顾问之间的密切互动有助于弥合优先事项上的差异，促进在作物保护策略上形成更为一致的观点。这些结果指出了研究人员和顾问可利用的关键指标，以更好地向农户传达替代作物保护方法，最终支持更可持续的农业实践。

title: The Cost of a Nutritious Diet in Cafeterias: Evidence From US Military Dining Facilities
title_zh: 食堂营养膳食的成本：来自美国军队餐饮设施的证据
title_primary: 食堂营养膳食的成本：来自美国军队餐饮设施的证据
title_secondary: The Cost of a Nutritious Diet in Cafeterias: Evidence From US Military Dining Facilities
authors: Linlin Fan, Yiwen Zhao, Andrea Carlson, Parke Wilde, Joanna Reagan 等
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Providing nutritious meals in institutional settings with financial constraints, such as military dining facilities, is challenging. The US Department of War (DoW) and US Department of Agriculture (USDA) collaborated to modernize the Basic Daily Food Allowance (BDFA) using an optimization model that incorporates service members' consumption patterns and nutritional standards. The model estimated optimal diets for four demographic groups, producing costs similar to the 2019 BDFA but with greater food variety. This first application of the USDA Food Plan to military purchase data demonstrates a flexible approach for improving cost estimates in military and other institutional food programs.
abstract_zh: 在资金受限的机构环境（如军队餐饮设施）中提供营养餐食颇具挑战。美国战争部与美国农业部合作，通过引入优化模型对基本每日食品津贴进行现代化改革，该模型整合了军人的消费模式与营养标准。模型为四个不同人口群体估算出最优膳食方案，其成本与2019年基本每日食品津贴相当，但食物种类更为丰富。此次将美国农业部食品计划首次应用于军购数据，展示了提升军队及其他机构食品项目成本估算灵活性的可行路径。

title: Sharing opportunities under externalities
title_zh: 外部性下的机会共享
title_primary: 外部性下的机会共享
title_secondary: Sharing opportunities under externalities
authors: Mohamed Belhaj, Frédéric Deroïan, Mathieu Faure
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A subset of economic agents in a society is aware of the existence of an economic opportunity, and compete to exploit it. We study incentives to communicate about the existence of this economic opportunity when its exploitation by the winner generates externalities to other agents. We characterize the equilibria of the communication game, identify conditions under which stronger externalities generate more communication, and highlight the tension between equilibrium and efficient communication.
abstract_zh: 社会中一部分经济主体知晓某一经济机会的存在，并竞相利用该机会。我们研究了当机会被赢家利用时对其他主体产生外部性的情况下，关于该经济机会存在信息的沟通激励。我们刻画了沟通博弈的均衡特征，识别了更强外部性促进更多沟通的条件，并强调了均衡沟通与有效沟通之间的张力。

title: The role of foreign capital flows in health finance
title_zh: 外国资本流动在卫生融资中的作用
title_primary: 外国资本流动在卫生融资中的作用
title_secondary: The role of foreign capital flows in health finance
authors: Mark Christopher Kelly
official: 官方在线 2026-04-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study develops an open economy version of the health deficit model to examine how rising health expenditures affect international capital flows, external balances, and welfare. The government issues bonds in international capital markets, linking health policy to international financial dynamics. Calibrated to the UK, the model evaluates income growth, medical innovation, and population aging shocks under balanced budget and deficit spending regimes. Results show that the source of health spending growth determines the direction of capital flows, and that deficit-financed health spending generally yields higher welfare by enabling additional health investment without higher domestic taxation.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了健康赤字模型的开放经济版本，以考察健康支出上升如何影响国际资本流动、外部平衡及福利。政府在国际资本市场上发行债券，将健康政策与国际金融动态联系起来。以英国为校准对象，该模型在平衡预算和赤字支出制度下评估了收入增长、医疗创新及人口老龄化冲击。结果表明，健康支出增长的来源决定了资本流动的方向，且赤字融资的健康支出通常能带来更高福利，因为这使得在不增加国内税收的情况下实现额外健康投资成为可能。

title: Fiscal policy and economic activity: new causal evidence
title_zh: 财政政策与经济活动：新的因果证据
title_primary: 财政政策与经济活动：新的因果证据
title_secondary: Fiscal policy and economic activity: new causal evidence
authors: David M. Brasington, Marios Zachariadis
official: 官方在线 2026-04-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Utilizing a quasi-natural experiment design, we identify an exogenous cut in local taxes accompanied by an equivalent reduction in local government spending, and we estimate the impact of these exogenous changes on income. We exploit a unique regional dataset that combines local income data with local voting outcomes on current expense tax levies. Taxes and the associated spending change abruptly at the 50 percent vote share cutoff below which a tax levy fails to pass. This cutoff determines which observations serve as controls and which receive treatment: a reduction in local taxes and government spending. Voting percentages around the cutoff are a source of exogenous variation, with observations around this quasi-randomly assigned and very similar across characteristics. We find that balanced budget reductions in taxes and spending cause a large drop in local incomes in the first two years after the vote, suggesting that government expenditure effects on income are larger than fiscal revenue effects. The cumulative government spending multiplier of a balanced-budget change in spending for our baseline is a sizable 1.5. This effect of local tax-financed government spending is prominent in low-income and high-poverty areas, suggestive of mechanisms related to the share of liquidity-constrained agents.
abstract_zh: 利用准自然实验设计，我们识别出地方税收的外生削减及与之等额的地方政府支出减少，并估计这些外生变化对收入的影响。我们利用一个独特的地域数据集，该数据集将地方收入数据与地方现行支出税征收的投票结果相结合。税收及相关支出在50%投票份额临界点处发生突变，低于此临界点，税收征收提案无法通过。这一临界点决定了哪些观测值作为对照组，哪些接受处理：即地方税收和政府支出的减少。临界点附近的投票百分比是外生变异的来源，这些观测值在此准随机分配下，各特征高度相似。我们发现，在投票后的头两年内，平衡预算下的税收与支出削减导致地方收入大幅下降，这表明政府支出对收入的影响大于财政收入效应。在我们的基线设定中，平衡预算支出变动的累积政府支出乘数高达1.5。这种地方税收融资的政府支出效应在低收入和高贫困地区尤为显著，暗示了与流动性受限代理人比例相关的机制。

title: The ESG-Innovation Disconnect: Evidence from Green Patenting
title_primary: The ESG-Innovation Disconnect: Evidence from Green Patenting
authors: Lauren H. Cohen, Umit G. Gurun, Quoc H. Nguyen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document that traditional energy firms are key innovators in the United States’ green patent landscape. These firms produce more, and significantly higher-quality, green innovation. In many green technology spaces, they appear to be influential first movers and to produce ongoing foundational aspects of innovation and commercialization on which other alternative energy producers build. They additionally invest significantly in labor and capital to complement these green innovations. These traditional energy firms, however, receive significantly lower environmental, social, and governance (ESG) scores and fund flows and are not rewarded for incremental green innovation. This behavior is consistent with a competitive response by traditional energy firms to preempt obsolescence of current technology by investing in future replacement technologies. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Funding: Funding was provided by the National Science Foundation [Grant SciSIP 1535813] and the Fordham University Gabelli School of Business—PVH Corp. Global Thought Leadership Grant on Corporate Social Responsibility. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.09124 .
